messages:
Amy Chen: getting page — graphs show embeddings QPS spike in us-west starting ~1759998600, CPU on embed workers at 95%
Raj Patel: saw that, impacted some enterprise customers. Are chat endpoints seeing error rates?
Maria Gomez: chat error rate slightly up (5xxs ~0.8%), embeddings 429s increasing. rerank fine.
ops-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: service=embed-route-us-west severity=high metric=429_rate threshold=0.5%
Amy Chen: ok switching to live mitigation plan. Step 1: enable per-endpoint throttles to shed non-critical embedding traffic.
Ethan Wu: proposed config: reduce embeddings QPS per-endpoint by 60% for free-tier routes, keep enterprise slices at 80% capacity.
Raj Patel: +1. Also recommend temporary disable of bulk-embeds endpoint (/v1/embeddings/bulk) to stop large batch jobs.
Maria Gomez: confirming customer impact: enterprise customers routed to dedicated hosts shouldn't be affected, public API heavy users will see 429s. We should notify status page.
Amy Chen: executing quick toggle. Command:
```
# set per-endpoint quota
redwoodctl quotas update --endpoint /v1/embeddings --region us-west --limit 40% --target free-tier
redwoodctl endpoints toggle --endpoint /v1/embeddings/bulk --region us-west --state disabled
```
ops-bot: ACTION LOGGED by Amy Chen: quotas:update embeddings free-tier -> 40% (us-west) at 1759998760
oncall-bot: ONCALL HANDOFF: Raj Patel now primary pager (1759998780)
Raj Patel: oncall acknowledged. Watching autoscaler and cache hit rates. If latency climbs, we'll enable KV cache-prefill and increase small-batch preference.
Ethan Wu: pushed rule to route non-priority embeddings to lower-cost pool with tighter quotas:
```
routing.rule add --match "route:public && model:gpt-embed" --target pool:spot-embed-us-west --max_qps 25
```
Maria Gomez: status page draft: "We are mitigating an embeddings traffic surge in US-WEST causing 429s for some public API requests. Enterprise traffic is largely unaffected. Engineers are applying temporary quota and routing changes." Approve?
Amy Chen: approve, post now. @statusbot please publish.
ops-bot: STATUS UPDATE: Embeddings public QPS down 65% in us-west, 429 rate dropping. Latency stable.
Raj Patel: monitoring customer support queue for high-severity tickets. @Maria please track any enterprise anomalies.
Maria Gomez: will do, reaching out to two customers on watchlist.
Ethan Wu: next step in 10m: if 429s <0.2% for 5m, we'll gradually relax quotas by 10% every 3m. If error rates resurge, fallback = re-enable bulk endpoint with strict rate limiting (max 10 qps per key).
Amy Chen: summarizing mitigation: 1) per-endpoint free-tier quota -> 40% 2) bulk embeddings disabled 3) public embeddings routed to spot pool 4) enterprise slices preserved. Handoff to Raj for monitoring.
Raj Patel: taking over. tagging this thread: #mitigation #embeddings #oncall-handoff
Amy Chen: thanks all :thumbsup:
_comment: Single Slack thread as continuous string. Messages in chronological order. No title field per agents.md.
